title: 내가 옳다고 믿었던 날의 끝
suno_analysis_sp: K-Indie folk ballad. Fingerpicked acoustic guitar in a steady eighth-note pattern. Soft, breathy female vocals with intimate, close-mic production and light plate reverb. Minimalist arrangement with no percussion or bass. Key of G Major, 72 BPM, 4/4 time signature. The vocal melody features gentle downward phrasing and subtle vibrato at the end of lines.
suno_analysis_lyrics:
[Intro]
[fingerpicked acoustic guitar]

[Verse 1]
[breathy female vocals]
할머니가 돌아가시고
한 달이 지났어요
집을 정리하러 갔어요
부엌을 열었어요
서랍에서 나무 도마가 나왔어요
무거웠어요 나무가 물을 먹어서요
칼자국이
